jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer

You'll work across the org: sometimes setting the standard, sometimes pair-programming a fix, sometimes helping a team define their error budget, sometimes telling them it's exhausted. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Billing
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Billing team at Supabase. Billing owns the monetization and revenue systems that turn platform usage into accurate customer charges and finance-ready revenue data. The team’s scope includes plans, subscriptions, usage-based billing, invoices, payments, credits, coupons, taxation, dunning, collections, pricing mechanics, entitlements, marketplace and partner billing paths, and integrations with providers such as Stripe and Orb. Billing sits at the intersection of engineering, product, finance, data, support, and partnerships. The systems are revenue-critical and trust-critical: they must remain correct, predictable, supportable, observable, and extensible as Supabase grows and introduces new products, pricing models, and partner channels. This is a people, delivery, and technical leadership role. We don’t expect managers to contribute production code directly, but we do expect you to participate in architecture and design discussions, challenge plans with sound technical reasoning, and set a high bar for correctness, reliability, and operational maturity. WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR Team & People - Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment. - Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports. - Coach engineers working across backend application code, data pipelines, external integrations, and operational workflows.

jobs.title: Head of AI Native Operations
jobs.description_text: About the Role We are looking for a Head of AI Native Operations to build the autonomous systems that run Supabase. Supabase is building an AI-native internal operating system, where agents carry the operational load end to end. We are standing up a new central team to build that platform and run it in production. This is the role that leads it, and it is hands-on. You design the architecture, build the first versions of the critical pieces, and are accountable for whether every agent we run is correct, safe, and improving over time. We build rather than buy, and there are no settled best practices for most of this yet, so you will be setting them. You will lead a team of senior individual contributors extending the platform and driving adoption across teams. What You’ll Be Responsible For In this role, you’ll: - Own the agent platform architecture: The harness and orchestration layer and connectors into company systems, shared context and memory, and the path from prototype to production. - Catch regressions before they ship: Model, prompt, and tool changes can’t ship until they pass the evals. When a new model comes out, you know within hours whether to adopt it. - Make every agent observable: Every run and every decision is traced. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Real-Time Generalist
jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Most full stack roles ask you to move pixels around a dashboard. This one asks you to help architect the system that controls the largest drone swarm on the planet. You’ll join the team building Legion, Swarm Aero’s Command & Control platform. Legion enables a single operator to plan, direct, and execute missions across a networked swarm of heterogeneous aircraft in real time, over intermittent communications, and at a scale nobody else in the industry is attempting. This is not a role maintaining a finished product or adding features around the edges. You’ll help define the architecture, establish core technical patterns, and build entirely new capabilities for a problem space with little prior art. The work spans real-time distributed systems, dense telemetry visualization, collaborative mission planning, and operator interfaces where clarity and reliability directly affect mission outcomes. You’ll have meaningful influence over what we build, how we build it, and how the platform evolves as the team and system scale. jobs.title: Structures Design Engineer, Airframe
jobs.description_text: About this Role We are building a Group 5 autonomous aircraft and driving it to first flight. We are in detailed design with tooling in work, and we are looking for a structures design engineer to own parts on that aircraft from concept through first article. You will design and size real hardware: control surfaces, ribs and spars, frames, doors and access panels, fittings and joints. You will take your parts all the way out, through analysis, drawings, vendor coordination, first article, and the fixes that come after. Our structures lead sets the architecture and the design approach. Inside that, your parts are yours. This is a role for someone who wants to design more and coordinate less. You will be in CAD and in FEA most days, and in the shop the rest of them. The aircraft is small enough as an organization that the person who draws a part is the person who sees it come off the tool, and finds out the same week whether the call they made was right. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own structural design and sizing for primary and secondary airframe structure, including wing, fuselage, empennage, and major joints - Develop the loads and criteria set for the aircraft and turn it into sized structure with documented margins - Run static, buckling, fatigue, and dynamic analysis in FEA, and know when hand calcs are the faster and better answer - Design in composites and metallics, and make the call on which belongs where based on weight, cost, and rate - Work directly with manufacturing on lay

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Rips (Web)
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Rips is one of the fastest growing apps in the collectibles space, and it lives on mobile today. You're going to bring it to the web. This is a greenfield build on top of backend systems that already work at scale. You'll own the web platform: the architecture, the conventions, the component patterns, the performance budget. The engineers who come after you will build inside the foundation you set, so we're looking for someone who has done this before. You'll be the first dedicated web engineer, but you won't be alone. Our engineers are deep in React already, and you'll be partnering with backend engineers who have spent the last two years building the systems you'll be consuming. What's missing is someone who owns the web surface end to end and has strong opinions about how it should be built. What You'll Do - Ship Rips on web, building on existing backend systems and APIs. - Set the technical foundation for our web platform: architecture, state management, build tooling, component patterns, testing strategy, and the standards that keep quality high as the team grows. - Own the user experience, not just the implementation. jobs.title: VIP Account Manager
jobs.description_text: About Triumph Triumph is a fast-growing gaming and trading card platform where players compete, rip packs, and chase big moments every day. Our VIP department exists for one reason: to make our most engaged players feel like the most important people on the platform — because to us, they are. We're not a faceless operator with a ticket queue and a canned macro library. Our edge is the relationship. Every VIP player at Triumph has a dedicated account manager — a person they know by name, who knows their story, their play style, and what actually matters to them. That's the moat, and you'd be part of it. The Role As a VIP Account Manager, you'll own a dedicated book of high-value players and be their single point of contact for everything Triumph. You're part concierge, part account manager, part trusted friend — the person they text when they hit a huge pull, when something breaks, or when they just want to talk shop. This is a high-agency, high-ownership role. You truly own your book of business — how you manage it, grow it, and take care of the players in it is up to you. Nobody's going to hand you a script or micromanage your outreach. We'll give you the tools, the data, and the backing; you bring the judgment and the drive. Your players' experience is your job, and your results are yours to own. What You'll Do - Own the relationship. We embrace AI-native engineering, using AI not only as the workload we optimize, but also as a tool to accelerate system development, experimentation, debugging, optimization, and adaptation to new models.
